verdict: Paid ads are off; Google profiles are your only active source of leads.
narrative: In the last 28 days, all measurable activity came from your three Google Business profiles — paid advertising on Meta and Google generated zero spend and zero leads this period. Your profiles logged 165 total actions (calls, direction requests, and website clicks) across roughly 1,210 impressions, but call volume dropped 33% in the most recent 7 days versus the prior 7, and the last three days of the window recorded zero profile actions. We are reviewing the paid channel status and Google profile performance this week to restore pipeline. You should expect a clearer picture of next steps, including paid reactivation timing, at the next check-in.
